data_source.access: Read-only Dash0 CLI queries with the owner-supplied auth token in process environment only.

traffic.earlier_run: An initial --minutes 10 run was interrupted at the owner request before launching this three-minute run. Earlier traffic remains visible in rolling Dash0 queries; the run is not an isolated load benchmark.
traffic.end_time_note: Launch observation plus tool-reported wall time; not an instrumented generator timestamp.

spec.description: 95 percent of /api/search and /api/onboarding requests complete within 500 ms (equivalent to p95 < 500 ms).
99 percent of companion-api responses are not 5xx.

trace.provenance: Root span started ~23:25:51Z, before the three-minute run launched at 23:27:13Z; this trace comes from the earlier interrupted run.
trace.redaction: Resource attributes, auth-token marker, trace-state, events and non-allowlisted span attributes omitted. This is a selected trace view, not an exhaustive privacy audit.

limitations: API query results are not screenshots of Dash0 dashboards or SLO pages and do not verify UI rendering.
Dashboard rate/latency queries use their configured 5-minute or 1-hour lookback, which includes preceding activity and other clients.
Native SLOs use rolling 28-day objectives; short run measurements cannot establish 28-day compliance.
Trace evidence omits non-allowlisted fields and Dash0-added resource auth markers; it is not an exhaustive privacy audit.
